newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra says no fall in consumer confidence.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra says no fall in consumer confidence.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Thursday that consumer confidence in Australia had not fallen.
"Consumer confidence has not declined at all," Costello told parliament.
"In fact, shortly after the election of this government this year consumer confidence rose and rose substantially."
The Westpac/Melbourne Institute consumer survey sentiment, released this month, showed a 3.9 percent fall in consumer confidence for October.
The survey said the main reason for the fall was uncertainty about economic prospects.
